title: The 15 links that explain today's earnings: Nvidia revenue +103%,Disney +16%, Weibo -7%. Who actually impressed you?
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Nvidia's fiscal Q3 revenue came in at $115.84 billion, up 103%, with  
EPS of $2.68 vs about $2.47 expected. Disney's revenue rose 16% with  
an EPS beat, and Home Depot's sales beat at $43.4 billion. Weibo's  
revenue fell 7%. Who beat, who missed, and who guided lower?  
  
Here is the rundown, drawn from today's write-ups.  
  
\*\*1. NVIDIA (NVDA)\*\* — NVIDIA reported revenue of $115.84 billion for  
the third quarter of fiscal 2027, up 103% year over year and ahead of  
both company guidance and consensus estimates. Non-GAAP earnings per  
share (EPS, a measure of profit per outstanding share) came in at  
$2.68 , beating the roughly $2.47 analysts had expected.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/nvidia-nvda-delivers-solid-fiscal-q3-results-amid-leadership-transition-39994/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/nvidia-nvda-delivers-solid-fiscal-q3-results-amid-leadership-transition-39994/)  
  
\*\*2. Disney (DIS)\*\* — Fiscal fourth-quarter revenue rose 16% year over  
year to $25.95 billion, while diluted earnings per share (EPS) climbed  
to $1.51 from $0.73 a year earlier. Adjusted EPS of $1.77 beat the  
consensus estimate of roughly $1.68, extending Disney's recent streak  
of above-guidance results.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/disney-dis-delivers-16-revenue-growth-in-fiscal-q4-with-solid-eps-beat-39997/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/disney-dis-delivers-16-revenue-growth-in-fiscal-q4-with-solid-eps-beat-39997/)  
  
\*\*3. The Home Depot (HD)\*\* — The Home Depot reported third-quarter  
fiscal 2026 sales of $43.4 billion , up 4.9% year over year and above  
analyst expectations. Adjusted diluted earnings per share (EPS) came  
in at $3.86 , up 3.2% from $3.74 a year earlier and in line with  
consensus estimates.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/the-home-depot-hd-reports-steady-q3-growth-despite-margin-headwinds-39996/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/the-home-depot-hd-reports-steady-q3-growth-despite-margin-headwinds-39996/)  
  
\*\*4. Amer Sports (AS)\*\* — Third-quarter 2026 revenue rose 24% year  
over year to $2.169 billion, or 23% excluding currency effects.  
Adjusted diluted earnings per share (EPS, a measure of profit  
allocated to each outstanding share) reached $0.42, up from $0.33 a  
year earlier and above consensus expectations.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/amer-sports-as-delivers-strong-q3-2026-results-with-24-revenue-growth-40007/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/amer-sports-as-delivers-strong-q3-2026-results-with-24-revenue-growth-40007/)  
  
\*\*5. ZTO Express (ZTO)\*\* — ZTO Express (Cayman) Inc. reported third  
quarter 2026 revenue of RMB14.36 billion (US$2.14 billion), up 21.0%  
year over year and above analyst estimates of roughly RMB13.9 billion.  
Adjusted diluted earnings per American depositary share (ADS) came in  
at RMB3.20 (US$0.48), slightly below the consensus estimate of  
RMB3.36.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/zto-express-zto-shows-21-revenue-growth-in-q3-despite-mixed-earnings-40011/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/zto-express-zto-shows-21-revenue-growth-in-q3-despite-mixed-earnings-40011/)  
  
\*\*6. Dolby Laboratories (DLB)\*\* — Dolby Laboratories reported  
fourth-quarter fiscal 2026 revenue of $373.5 million, up 21.7% year  
over year. Adjusted (non-GAAP) earnings per share (EPS) came in at  
$1.25, beating the consensus estimate of $1.19.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/dolby-laboratories-dlb-delivers-q4-revenue-beat-but-guides-below-expectations-40017/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/dolby-laboratories-dlb-delivers-q4-revenue-beat-but-guides-below-expectations-40017/)  
  
\*\*7. Elbit Systems (ESLT)\*\* — Revenue rose 17.2% year over year to  
$2.252 billion, up from $1.922 billion in the third quarter of 2025.  
Non-GAAP (non-Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) diluted EPS  
(earnings per share) reached $4.36, a 30% increase from $3.35 a year  
earlier.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/elbit-systems-eslt-delivers-solid-q3-2026-results-driven-by-defense-demand-40003/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/elbit-systems-eslt-delivers-solid-q3-2026-results-driven-by-defense-demand-40003/)  
  
\*\*8. [JD.com](http://JD.com) (JD)\*\* — Net revenues rose 3.5% year over year to RMB309.6  
billion (US$46.2 billion), marking a return to positive growth after a  
weaker prior quarter. Non-GAAP (non-Generally Accepted Accounting  
Principles) net income attributable to ordinary shareholders climbed  
44% to RMB8.3 billion (US$1.2 billion).  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/jd-com-jd-delivers-3-5-revenue-growth-and-margin-expansion-in-q3-39995/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/jd-com-jd-delivers-3-5-revenue-growth-and-margin-expansion-in-q3-39995/)  
  
\*\*9. Klarna (KLAR)\*\* — Revenue beat expectations: Klarna Group plc  
(NYSE: KLAR) reported third-quarter 2026 revenue of $1.01 billion, up  
12% year over year and above consensus estimates of roughly $964  
million to $983 million. Bottom line still in the red: The company  
posted a net loss of $65 million, or $0.19 per share, wider than the  
roughly $0.13 per-share loss analysts had expected, though narrower  
than the $95 million loss a year earlier.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/klarna-klar-delivers-revenue-beat-in-q3-2026-as-losses-narrow-40021/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/klarna-klar-delivers-revenue-beat-in-q3-2026-as-losses-narrow-40021/)  
  
\*\*10. Cadence Design Systems (CDNS)\*\* — Raised 2026 guidance signals  
momentum: Cadence lifted its full-year 2026 revenue outlook to roughly  
$6.39–$6.42 billion, implying about 21% growth, with non-GAAP  
(non-Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) earnings per share of  
$8.37–$8.43. Record backlog supports revenue visibility: A record $8.2  
billion backlog and a recurring-revenue mix approaching 80% provide  
unusually strong forward visibility across...  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/cadence-design-systems-cdns-raises-2026-guidance-with-21-revenue-growth-outlook-39510/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/cadence-design-systems-cdns-raises-2026-guidance-with-21-revenue-growth-outlook-39510/)  
  
\*\*11. Opera (OPRA)\*\* — Revenue grew 20% year-over-year to $182.8  
million, landing at the top of the company's guidance range. Adjusted  
diluted EPS (earnings per share) rose 16% year-over-year to $0.34,  
while GAAP (Generally Accepted Accounting Principles) diluted EPS  
climbed 49% to $0.30.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/opera-opra-delivers-20-revenue-growth-in-q3-despite-guidance-caution-40039/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/opera-opra-delivers-20-revenue-growth-in-q3-despite-guidance-caution-40039/)  
  
\*\*12. Tencent Music (TME)\*\* — Total revenue rose 5.6% year over year  
to RMB8.94 billion (US$1.33 billion), led by continued strength in  
music-related services. Non-IFRS diluted earnings per ADS (American  
Depositary Share) came in at RMB1.55 (US$0.23), modestly ahead of  
consensus expectations of roughly RMB1.50.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/tencent-music-tme-delivers-resilient-q3-results-driven-by-music-services-40008/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/tencent-music-tme-delivers-resilient-q3-results-driven-by-music-services-40008/)  
  
\*\*13. MINISO (MNSO)\*\* — Revenue rose 14.3% year over year (YoY) to  
RMB6.63 billion (US$988.2 million), driven by a 29.6% jump in MINISO's  
Chinese mainland business. Adjusted earnings per share (EPS) of  
RMB2.36 beat the consensus estimate of RMB2.29, while non-GAAP  
(non-standard accounting) earnings per American Depositary Share (ADS)  
of $0.35 topped forecasts by $0.03.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/miniso-mnso-q3-earnings-14-3-revenue-growth-meets-profit-pressure-40025/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/miniso-mnso-q3-earnings-14-3-revenue-growth-meets-profit-pressure-40025/)  
  
\*\*14. Viking (VIK)\*\* — Third quarter 2026 revenue rose 9.2% year over  
year to $2.18 billion, but adjusted earnings per share (EPS) of $1.11  
landed below the roughly $1.26 consensus estimate. Historic low water  
levels on European rivers reduced quarterly revenue and adjusted gross  
margin by approximately $100 million each and drove occupancy down to  
91.3% from 96.0% a year earlier.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/viking-holdings-vik-q3-earnings-show-resilience-with-9-2-revenue-growth-39998/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/viking-holdings-vik-q3-earnings-show-resilience-with-9-2-revenue-growth-39998/)  
  
\*\*15. Weibo (WB)\*\* — Weibo reported net revenues of $410.2 million for  
the third quarter of 2026, down 7% year over year (13% on a  
constant-currency basis). Advertising and marketing revenue fell 8% to  
$344.1 million, as cautious advertiser spending and a high prior-year  
comparison base weighed on results.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/weibo-wb-q3-2026-earnings-revenues-decline-7-as-ad-spending-weakens-40038/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/weibo-wb-q3-2026-earnings-revenues-decline-7-as-ad-spending-weakens-40038/)  
  
Who actually impressed you?  
  
Not financial advice. Figures are from today's (Nov 17) write-ups,  
using intraday or latest-close prices, not live quotes. Price targets  
are targets, not promises.
